plants.sentence: The final posterior depends on the order in which the data are observed, so the same data seen in a different order give a different posterior.
An R-hat of 1 proves that the simulation has converged and that its posterior approximation is exact, so no other diagnostic is ever needed.
As the sample grows, the prior gains influence over the posterior, while the influence of the data diminishes.
A Bayes factor describes how likely the data are under one hypothesis relative to another; Harold Jeffreys introduced it in the 1930s.
The poll in which 30 of 50 people supported the candidate caused her actual support among voters to rise from about 45% to 50%.
